content: {"summary":"On 15 Oct 2025 the catalog‑api connection pool was exhausted because an ALTER TABLE migration waited for an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock, causing 30 catalog_app sessions to block and reach the QueuePool limit, which produced edge 504 errors on cache‑miss requests.","likely_cause":"ALTER TABLE migration lock contention filled the SQLAlchemy pool","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"The ALTER TABLE migration waited for an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock, causing all new SELECT/UPDATE statements to block behind it.","evidence_ids":["RB-028#2"],"quote":"every new SELECT or UPDATE on products waited behind the ALTER"},{"text":"30 catalog_app sessions were blocked by the ALTER's pid, filling the pool to its limit.","evidence_ids":["RB-028#4"],"quote":"30 catalog_app sessions, each blocked by the ALTER's pid"},{"text":"QueuePool limit errors were logged when connections timed out after 30 seconds.","evidence_ids":["log:3931"],"quote":"QueuePool limit of size 10 overflow 5 reached"}],"next_checks":["Check for any other long‑running transactions on products at the incident time","Verify that the migration cancellation cleared the blocked sessions as recorded","Review cache miss metrics to confirm the proportion of requests that hit the DB"]}
